verdict.rationale: Windmill serves a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 "Windmill API" document on its cloud instance. The source spec is versioned in the official repo, a hosted Scalar API reference is linked from llms.txt, and scoped tokens and a backward-compatibility release policy cover the API. The probe 404s were on the marketing domain, not the app host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and the noted lag of the deployed spec behind the source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Windmill's cloud instance serves its OpenAPI 3.0.3 document live at /api/openapi.json (info title "Windmill API")
Windmill vendor-hosts a Scalar API Reference at app.windmill.dev/openapi.html rendering the live spec
The source-of-truth spec lives in the official windmill-labs/windmill repository (backend/windmill-api/openapi.yaml), versioned with each release.
The OpenAPI spec version tracks the release version, so the policy covers the API.
Tokens can be scoped to restrict access to specific resources and actions, following the principle of least privilege.
